from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

repository = Path('/workspace/koda')
active = Path('/workspace/android-studio-parallel-sync-policy')
snapshot_path = Path('/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/parallel-sync-integration/combined-whole-source-snapshot.json')
snapshot = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text())
destination = snapshot_path.parent / 'archived-planning-checkouts.json'
assert not destination.exists()

def git(path, *arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *arguments], cwd=path)

def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

protected_before = {name: git(repository, 'rev-parse', name).decode().strip() for name in ['HEAD', 'main', 'android-studio']}
assert not git(repository, 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
assert not git(Path('/workspace/android-studio-target'), 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
assert git(active, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == snapshot['source_commit']
for name, expected in snapshot['files'].items():
    assert digest(active / name) == expected, name
records = []
for name in ['android-studio-plan', 'android-studio-window-inventory']:
    path = Path('/workspace') / name
    assert not git(path, 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
    assert not git(path, 'ls-files', '--others', '--ignored', '--exclude-standard')
    branch = git(path, 'branch', '--show-current').decode().strip()
    commit = git(path, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
    assert branch.startswith('android-studio-task/')
    remote = git(repository, 'ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/' + branch).decode().split()
    assert remote == [commit, 'refs/heads/' + branch]
    files = {}
    for name_bytes in git(path, 'ls-files', '-z').split(b'\0'):
        if name_bytes:
            tracked = name_bytes.decode()
            assert (path / tracked).is_file()
            files[tracked] = digest(path / tracked)
    records.append({'path': str(path), 'retained_branch': branch, 'retained_commit': commit,
                    'retained_tree': git(path, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip(),
                    'remote_branch_exact_commit_verified': True,
                    'clean_with_no_untracked_or_ignored_files': True, 'tracked_file_sha256': files,
                    'restore_command': ['git', 'worktree', 'add', str(path), branch]})
destination.write_text(json.dumps({'status': 'prepared_not_removed', 'records': records}, indent=2) + '\n')
for record in records:
    subprocess.run(['git', 'worktree', 'remove', record['path']], cwd=repository, check=True)
    assert not Path(record['path']).exists()
    assert git(repository, 'rev-parse', record['retained_branch']).decode().strip() == record['retained_commit']
for name, expected in protected_before.items():
    assert git(repository, 'rev-parse', name).decode().strip() == expected
assert not git(repository, 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
assert not git(Path('/workspace/android-studio-target'), 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
for name, expected in snapshot['files'].items():
    assert digest(active / name) == expected, name
destination.write_text(json.dumps({'status': 'duplicate_checkouts_removed_branches_and_history_retained',
    'records': records, 'protected_refs_before_and_after_identical': protected_before,
    'active_source_commit': snapshot['source_commit'], 'active_source_files_unchanged': len(snapshot['files']),
    'no_forced_removal_no_ref_deletion_no_history_rewrite': True}, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'removed_duplicate_checkouts': [r['path'] for r in records],
                  'all_branches_and_git_history_retained': True, 'active_source_files_unchanged': len(snapshot['files'])}))
